query: I have a 48‑year‑old man. Among male patients aged 43–53 admitted with ACS and initial hs‑Troponin T >99th percentile (ULN), what are the median and IQR of initial values in ng/mL?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS interquartile_range, median(value) AS median_value FROM labevents JOIN patients ON labevents.subject_id = patients.subject_id JOIN admissions ON labevents.subject_id = admissions.subject_id WHERE patients.gender = 'M' AND patients.anchor_age = 48 AND admissions.admission_type = 'ACS' AND itemid = 757071 AND value > percentile_cont(0.99) within GROUP (ORDER BY value);
